query:
SELECT id, companyName, status,
  LEFT(coreCapabilities, 30) as cap_preview,
  LEFT(valuePropositions, 30) as vp_preview,
  LEFT(fitCriteria, 30) as fit_preview,
  LEFT(urgencyTriggers, 30) as urgency_preview
FROM offering_brains
WHERE status = 'completed'
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 3;
